description:
[read-only] The brand's "posts like this must carry a credit" rules and its mode (flag / push_down). In push_down mode publish refuses or holds a post missing a required credit — add `credits` with update_content first.
(Wraps GET /api/v2/attribution-rules.)

brandId.description: Account-wide keys: "personal" or an id from GET /api/v2/brands (omitted → the brand last active in the dashboard). A brand-bound key always uses its own brand.

name: list_attribution_rules
title: List creator-credit rules
